title: Discovery & Capability Architecture
note: Every requirement is a real Phase 04 obligation. All were APPROVED by the User on 2026-10-03; the agent implemented them but did not approve them.

requirements.title: Capability discovery and lifecycle model
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Capability discovery and lifecycle model
acceptance_criteria: A 14-state capability lifecycle is documented in .sps/capability/CAPABILITY-MODEL.md
Each state records who may set it; APPROVED is user-only
The lifecycle maps onto the Phase 03 model rather than duplicating it
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Separate FACT, EVIDENCE, INFERENCE, UNKNOWN claim classes
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Separate FACT, EVIDENCE, INFERENCE, UNKNOWN claim classes
acceptance_criteria: All four claim classes are defined in .sps/capability/CAPABILITY-MODEL.md
validate-capability.sh rejects UNKNOWN rendered as known
A positive control proves a valid record is still accepted
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Capability and research contracts
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Capability and research contracts
acceptance_criteria: SCHEMA.md defines a capability contract and a research contract
Registry and research cache are valid JSON with enforced field rules
The registry is empty - no capability is fabricated
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Security gate where UNKNOWN is never safe
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Security gate where UNKNOWN is never safe
acceptance_criteria: SECURITY.md defines a security enum where UNKNOWN blocks install
validate-capability.sh rejects UNKNOWN security rendered as safe
The threat model covers malicious, abandoned, compromised and typosquatted sources
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Project-local activation is the default
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Project-local activation is the default
acceptance_criteria: PROJECT_LOCAL is the default install scope
A GLOBAL scope without authorization is rejected
A GLOBAL scope authorized by an agent is rejected
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: MCP capabilities evaluated, never assumed safe
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: MCP capabilities evaluated, never assumed safe
acceptance_criteria: An MCP contract with trust_level and rollback is defined
Installing an untrusted MCP is rejected
No MCP is installed during Phase 04
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Technology research gate before selection
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Technology research gate before selection
acceptance_criteria: A research contract covers ten areas and demands a rank<=4 source
A selection whose research is not SUFFICIENT is rejected
The research cache is project-local, never agent or machine memory
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Provenance chain with honest enforcement levels
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Provenance chain with honest enforcement levels
acceptance_criteria: A provenance chain links requirement through to usage
Enforcement is reported as ENFORCED, VALIDATED, DOCUMENTED or DECLARED
Runtime provenance tracking is explicitly NOT claimed
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Staleness and source-priority rules
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Staleness and source-priority rules
acceptance_criteria: Six source ranks are defined; community popularity never establishes correctness
Staleness fields and re-evaluation triggers are documented
A STALE capability presented as current is rejected
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Agent-neutral architecture
acceptance_criteria: Only Markdown, JSON and plain shell are used - no agent runtime required
Slash commands are not a mandatory dependency
An AGENT_NEUTRAL claim carrying an agent-specific dependency is rejected
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Audit of the existing hardcoded skill routing
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Audit of the existing hardcoded skill routing
acceptance_criteria: Hardcoded routing is measured from the repository, not assumed
The specific points preventing dynamic selection are enumerated
A staged migration plan exists; the legacy router is not removed
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: No-emoji rule
acceptance_criteria: A no-emoji rule is stated in .sps/capability/CAPABILITY-MODEL.md
Icon libraries are selectable capabilities, not a fixed default
The repository's own emoji usage is recorded as a known issue
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Validation rejects invalid capability states
requirements.description: Phase 04 obligation: Validation rejects invalid capability states
acceptance_criteria: Cases A through N are each constructed and each must be rejected
A positive control proves a valid capability is still accepted
validate-capability.sh exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 missed cases
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 04 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.
